description: `MINIMUM_STAKE = 1e15` is documented as "Minimum stake amount to prevent first depositor attack (0.001 phUSD)". The first-depositor / share-inflation attack pattern targets share-based vaults where `shares = assets * totalSupply() / totalAssets()` and the first depositor can dust-inflate the price. PhlimboEA uses a MasterChef debt-accounting model (per-share accumulators + per-user debts), NOT a share-mint model: `userInfo[u].amount` IS the stake principal, no shares are minted, no exchange rate exists. Therefore `MINIMUM_STAKE` does not actually defend against the named attack — it only acts as a dust floor on the first stake and as a withdraw-dust forcer. The pattern signature (`totalSupply() == 0`, `if (supply == 0)`) does NOT appear in the contract; this is flagged because the comment falsely advertises a defense, which is a common QA-tier observation. No exploitable consequence in the local code.
snippet:
/// @notice Minimum stake amount to prevent first depositor attack (0.001 phUSD)
uint256 public constant MINIMUM_STAKE = 1e15;
note: Pattern signature did NOT structurally match (no totalSupply()==0 branch); included as a documentation-mismatch QA candidate. Low priority — likely to be deduped or demoted.
